summary: This June 23 Dante #7 source extends the Dante cluster by turning Hell into a map of failed reality contact: faith, hope, and love collapse into fantasy, meritocratic rivalry, civic exclusion, fraud, and post-truth divination.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: prophecy is a critique of the present, not mere fortune-telling; Dante becomes legible as prophet when catastrophe makes the present's moral structure visible.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source supplies a sharp later Dante version of the poet-prophet-teacher anchor: prophetic poetry diagnoses the present and wounds before it comforts.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: the early circles of Hell show not excess desire but too little ego, will, hope, and action; the AI-wife example turns lust into self-abandonment.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The read has exact marks for weak will and self-abandonment that can later link to Free Will only if a provenance pass keeps the hover narrow and avoids making every lust passage a Free Will link.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: meritocracy makes friends into enemies by turning nearby success into humiliation and then teaching winners that the hierarchy is deserved.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source does not repeat the admissions-trauma mechanism exactly, but it strongly extends the same child page's social psychology from credential wound into rivalry, cruelty, and deserved-hierarchy ideology.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: usury exploits another person's capacity to co-create with God, while money becomes the common language of a society whose shared values have dissolved.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is not a modern dollar or finance append, but it gives a Dante-theological background layer for money as spiritual theft and social substitute.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for the next Poetry parent compression: this source gives the Inferno side of Dante's public function, where prophecy critiques the present, catastrophe changes reception, and beauty persuades without shrinking free will.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns Dante's prophetic medium and reception. Prediction owns falsifiable public forecasting; Free Will owns the agency burden; Guide Trap and Imperial Poetry own Virgil when inherited authority or imperial world-making is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only in a future Free Will replacement/compression: faith is imagination, hope is the arrogant belief that actions matter, love is action, and incontinence becomes not taking oneself seriously enough to exercise will.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns agency, hope, self-seriousness, and chosen spiritual station. Love Recognizes owns the concrete relational failure; AI Control owns machine intimacy only when the interface itself is the control surface.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Francesca and the AI-wife thought experiment as relational failure pressure: lust is fantasy that loves an idea, romance plot, celebrity image, or machine substitute rather than a real person.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Love Recognizes owns the failure to see and answer a concrete beloved. Free Will owns weak will and self-abandonment; Attention owns fantasy capture; AI Control owns the artificial companion as command interface only when the machine system is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as a later Dante/Florence layer if the Meritocracy child is expanded: elite competition becomes infernal because it makes friends enemies, moralizes winners, and replaces embarrassment about inequality with deserved-rank certainty.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Meritocracy owns the credentialed rivalry mechanism. Education owns school formation; Human Heart owns relation damage only when love, trust, or forgiveness is the active object.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the rock-bottom and civic-decline material for future Human Heart compression: love may force reality rather than enable delusion, and a civilization that cannot sustain shared values falls into money, distrust, censorship, bureaucracy, post-truth, and degraded standards.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns love as reality-forcing care and the civilizational measure of relation. Power owns money as operating sign; Bureaucracy owns procedure; Stories or Fraud seed owns post-truth when manipulation of perception is central.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold usury and money-as-common-language as background evidence for future Power compression, not an ordinary append: the source frames finance as exploiting co-creation and as the substitute value that appears when shared civic meaning fails.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns money becoming reality or spiritual/social substitute. Dollar Hegemony, Chokepoint, and Platform Infrastructure should not absorb this source unless later public work needs modern finance machinery.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Augustus/Virgil crisis for a future Imperial Poetry compression: Augustus may be absent because imperial power corrupted divine poetry to serve empire, and Virgil keeps his memory alive while remaining the suspect guide.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Poetry owns the imperial capture of poetic world-making. Guide Trap owns Virgil as necessary but suspect mediator; Poetry parent owns Dante's broader access method.

new_lens_seeds.title: Fraud Kills Reality Contact
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Fraud is worse than ordinary violence because it recruits trust in order to poison perception: lies make people question reality, simony sells authority, diviners shrink free will, and media actors can turn civilization into an atmosphere where truth can no longer be discussed.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism connects Inferno's fraud circles to Jiang's wider concerns about propaganda, institutional authority, post-truth, credential sale, divination, and narrative manipulation without reducing them to generic misinformation.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed until compared against Stories, Attention, Bureaucracy, Education, and Power. Do not create standalone Fraud, Geryon, Simony, Fortune Tellers, Journalists, Post-Truth, Credential Sale, or Media Diviners pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Rock Bottom As Severe Love
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Love may become severe when a person or civilization can no longer live inside delusion; forcing contact with reality can be mercy rather than cruelty when forgiveness alone would preserve self-destruction.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source gives a portable theological and therapeutic pattern that could compare Dante, prophecy, addiction, family care, civilization collapse, and Jiang's broader critique of polite unreality.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. Human Heart can carry this for now; a public child would need multiple dated sources showing severe love as a recurring mechanism rather than one Dante theological answer.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-06-23, this source is later than the April 8 and April 29 Inferno sources and follows the June 15-18 Paradiso cluster. Public synthesis should not let processing order make it the origin layer; it is a later classroom re-entry into Hell after Paradiso material has already clarified imagination, free will, and reception.

The source gives a distinct later formulation of the Dante agency line: faith is imagination, hope is the belief that one's action matters, love is action, and weak will appears as fantasy, passivity, and self-abandonment rather than as strong desire.
This source clarifies the Inferno side of Dante's prophetic role: prophecy is not mere prediction but present critique whose truth may become visible only after catastrophe changes reception.

The late fraud sequence moves from Dante's lower Hell to modern universities, media actors, censorship, distrust, and post-truth; treat this as seed pressure until enough dated sources prove the fraud-as-reality-killing mechanism needs its own public page.

next_actions.note: Do not create standalone Dante #7, Hell, Lust, AI Wife, Francesca, Prophecy, Rock Bottom, Meritocracy, Florence, Immigration, Usury, Fraud, Geryon, Simony, Fortune Tellers, Media Diviners, Post-Truth, Augustus, or Virgil Villain pages from this source alone.

The next useful public Dante move remains Poetry parent compression from the #1167 split plan, preserving existing anchors while deciding whether Dante reception/access requires a child. This source should feed that compression only where prophecy, fraud, and reception clarify the parent.

Before promoting Fraud Kills Reality Contact, compare it against Stories, Attention, Bureaucracy, Education, Power, Prediction, and any prior media/post-truth impacts so it becomes a reusable mechanism rather than a Dante-topic page.

If episode-to-lens links are applied later, link only exact marks for prophecy-as-present-critique, weak-will/self-abandonment, meritocracy rivalry, usury/co-creation, and fraud killing reality contact; do not bulk-link every Dante or Inferno mark.
